name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
how_to:
Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift Benefits
- The Kettlebell single leg deadlift is an effective exercise to strengthen, tone, tighten the butt muscles and improve balance.
- The Kettlebell single leg deadlift secondarily works your core muscles, as your abdominals and obliques contract to stabilize your body. This exercise also works the erector spinae muscles in your back that help support your spine and provide flexibility when bending in multiple directions.
- Kettlebell single-leg deadlifts can improve balance and correct strength imbalances in the hips. Every time you stand on one leg, you use the same muscles for balance and stability that are often used to build strength. Improving the ability of each leg to work and produce force will help skyrocket your back squat and deadlift numbers!
